question_en: Which RAN5 specs were changed in each release? (release-level change map)
original_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release), (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN rel.releaseName, sp.specNumber, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 10
reference_query:
MATCH (rel:Release)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rel)<-[:TARGET_RELEASE]-(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec)
WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' AND NOT sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.591'
RETURN rel.releaseName AS releaseName, collect(DISTINCT sp.specNumber) AS specNumbers
ORDER BY releaseName ASC

cardinality_policy.notes: Every distinct recorded Release identity is represented with its complete distinct set of RAN5 requested-target specNumber identities in the preserved Phase3 38.5xx domain excluding38.591; releases with no qualifying recorded target retain an empty set. No release or spec-membership cap is introduced.
